content: Hello! how can I help today?
My business had a huge loss this year. Can I get a refund from prior years?

Yes—use a **Net Operating Loss (NOL)** carryback. While recent law removed automatic carrybacks, certain losses (e.g., 2020–2021 or farming businesses) may still qualify.

Use **Form 1045** to apply it across prior years and claim a quick refund.
What’s the advantage of filing Form 1045 over an amended return?
**Form 1045** provides a **faster refund** process (typically 90 days). It applies across up to five years of income, refigures tax each year, and avoids multiple 1040-X filings.
Do I need to file anything with my current return?
Yes. Attach **Schedule A (NOL computation)** and **Schedule B (carryback)** to your current-year return. This establishes your loss and allows Form 1045 to be processed.
What if my NOL spans both carryback and carryforward years?
Apply it to the earliest year first. Once exhausted, any remainder becomes a **carryforward** under §172. Track the full usage across each year to avoid double-claiming.
